infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EcoEats needs access to your photos so you can add pictures of the food you're posting.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: EcoEats uses the camera so you can take a photo of the food you're posting.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: EcoEats turns what you say into the description of the food you're posting.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: EcoEats uses the microphone so you can describe food by speaking instead of typing.

plugins.photosPermission: EcoEats needs access to your photos so you can add pictures of the food you're posting.
plugins.cameraPermission: EcoEats uses the camera so you can take a photo of the food you're posting.

plugins.microphonePermission: EcoEats uses the microphone so you can describe food by speaking instead of typing.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: EcoEats turns what you say into the description of the food you're posting.
